text: The alarm clock rings indicating the start of the day. It's 6:00 AM. You are forced to open your eyes for one reason or another.
You decide to get out of bed.
You decide to go back to sleep.
You decided to go sit at your desk and turn on your PC. When you see the login screen you decide to enter your password, a numeric sequence of eight characters.
You decided to go to school, without having breakfast or saying goodbye to anyone.
You decided to go to breakfast.
You decide to open Tor browser outside of a VM.
You decide to open Tor Browser inside of a VM.
options: Open Tor browser in a VM.
